# Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters — facts

> Source-anchored units about Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters: 12 across 4 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## How it works

- [statement] Collection typing does not reject every unknown filter key: fields absent from the declared schema receive any. Plex independently describes misspelled fields escaping checks because driver helper types include Document. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters · also: https://medium.com/plexlabs/making-the-world-type-safe-for-mongodb-queries-papr-v11-46266bb87594
- [statement] Nested instances of self-recursive types lose dot-notation type safety because the driver avoids traversing those recursive types. The guide recommends querying or updating without dot notation when those nested checks are required. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters
- [statement] find and findOne infer the returned _id type from the collection schema; when the schema omits _id, the inferred type is ObjectId. A collection type parameter affects inference and does not convert stored field values. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] In NODE-5290, a reporter using mongodb@5.5.0 demonstrated that StrictMatchKeysAndValues accepted false for an optional nested string property, while the corresponding required property produced a type error. This is historical reported behavior, not a verification of later releases. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/NODE-5290 · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Pass the document interface to database.collection<Pet>() to type a collection. Driver classes accepting document type parameters default to Document, whose string index signature accepts any value. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters
- [statement] Starting with driver version 5.0, ordinary filters do not type-check values for dot-notation paths by default. Opt into StrictFilter or StrictUpdateFilter for stronger nested-path checking. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters · also: https://medium.com/plexlabs/making-the-world-type-safe-for-mongodb-queries-papr-v11-46266bb87594, https://github.com/plexinc/papr/blob/main/docs/recipes.md
- [statement] StrictFilter and StrictUpdateFilter are experimental. They can reject valid queries, and their shapes may change without a major version bump. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters · also: https://github.com/mongodb/node-mongodb-native/blob/main/EXPERIMENTAL_FEATURES.md
- [statement] The Collection type parameter affects inferred return types; it does not convert stored field values to the declared TypeScript types. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters
- [statement] find and findOne infer a returned _id from the collection schema; if the schema omits _id, the inferred type is ObjectId. OptionalId makes a required model _id optional for collection inserts. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters
- [statement] Projection does not automatically make the inferred find result match the projected shape. The driver guide instructs callers to supply an explicit result type parameter, such as findOne<ProjectedDocument>(), to catch access to excluded fields. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters
- [statement] The driver guide uses an as const assertion on a computed dot-notation key containing a variable so TypeScript preserves the key type, illustrated by the mealtimes array index example. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters
- [statement] If a model requires _id but insert callers should be allowed to omit it, wrap the collection schema in OptionalId; that helper makes the model’s _id field optional for insertion. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md · keywords: Node.js driver TypeScript typing of collections and filters
